The failure is also more pronounced in visual than textual uncertainty: models detect textual impossibility about 4x more readily than missing visual evidence. Closing this representation--output gap likely requires output-stage interventions.

articles.titleCn: TRAPSBench：视觉语言模型能够编码但无法表达认知约束
articles.abstractCn: 当视觉证据被遮挡或混乱时，模型应当回避。在本文中，我们表明视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够在内部区分何时需要回避，但无法表达出来。我们引入了TRAPSBench，这是一个程序生成的视频基准，包含1,404对匹配的物理场景，其中单一的目标改变使得从视觉证据中无法确定结果。此外，我们引入了惩罚性认知校准分数（PECS），这是一种新的鲁棒性指标，要求模型在结果可知时正确回答，在结果不可知时回避。在涵盖五个系列的16个VLMs中，自发的约束表现不佳：最佳PECS分数为0.292。瓶颈在于表达而非感知：线性探针在物理领域从隐藏状态解码可解性，AUROC高达0.91；通过单层空方向进行因果引导，可以诱导或抑制回避。我们的结果在三个开放权重系列（Qwen、Gemma、LLaVA）中得到了验证。这种失败在视觉不确定性上比文本不确定性更为明显：模型检测文本不可能性的速度大约是检测视觉证据缺失的四倍。弥补这种表征-输出差距可能需要输出阶段的干预。

articles.title: Better Decomposition, Free Aggregation: A Synthesizer-Folding Framework for Multilingual Multi-Hop Question Answering
articles.abstract: Multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) equips large language models with access to globally distributed external knowledge for complex multilingual question answering. Recent approaches either translate retrieved documents into English or the query language to bridge the cross-lingual semantic gap, or decompose a complex query into sub-questions and aggregate the intermediate reasoning process. However, both lines of work suffer from two limitations. First, one-size-fits-all translation alignment, blanket translation discards culturally and linguistically native information unique to the target language, introduces translation noise, and inflates system cost. Second, greedy decomposition and aggregation, uncontrolled decomposition produces redundant sub-questions that compound errors during step-wise reasoning, and the final aggregation over reasoning paths further amplifies these errors. We address both with our method Syfer, a synthesizer-folding framework for multilingual multi-hop question answering that defers translation rather than applying it by default. Syfer first invokes a format-constrained decomposer to produce a sub-question graph in the original language, followed by a decomposition-quality check; when the check passes, sub-questions are answered sequentially under a retrieve-then-answer policy in the target language, and the English translation pathway with bilingual sub-question graph alignment is activated only when the check fails. Experiments across multiple languages show that Syfer attains competitive accuracy while striking a favourable balance between performance and computational cost.
articles.titleCn: 更好的分解，自由聚合：多语言多跳问答的合成器折叠框架
articles.abstractCn: 多语言检索增强生成（mRAG）为大型语言模型提供了访问全球分布式外部知识的能力，以支持复杂的跨语言问答。近期方法或通过将检索到的文档翻译成英语或查询语言来弥合跨语言语义鸿沟，或通过将复杂查询分解为子问题并聚合中间推理过程。然而，这两种方法都存在两个局限性。首先，通用翻译对齐方法，即全翻译方法，会丢弃目标语言特有的文化和语言信息，引入翻译噪声，并增加系统成本。其次，贪婪分解和聚合，不受控制的分解会产生冗余的子问题，在逐步推理过程中加剧错误，而最终对推理路径的聚合进一步放大了这些错误。我们通过我们的方法Syfer来解决这些问题，Syfer是一个用于多语言多跳问答的综合折叠框架，它推迟翻译而不是默认应用翻译。Syfer首先调用一个格式约束的分解器，以原始语言生成子问题图，然后进行分解质量检查；当检查通过时，子问题在目标语言中以检索后回答的策略顺序回答，而当检查失败时，才会激活包含双语子问题图对齐的英语翻译路径。跨多种语言的实验表明，Syfer在性能和计算成本之间取得了有利平衡，实现了具有竞争力的准确率。

articles.title: LigBench: A Unified and Human-Aligned Benchmark for LLM-based Research Idea Generation
articles.abstract: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), research idea generation has attracted increasing attention. Existing approaches enable LLMs to retrieve relevant literature and propose novel ideas for research areas. However, current evaluation practices for idea generation remain fragmented and lack objective standards, often relying on direct LLM scoring, which limits their ability to provide unified and reliable assessments across a coherent distribution of generated ideas. To address this challenge, we propose LigBench, an automated evaluation benchmark that enables fine-grained and reliable evaluation of AI research ideas, consistently applicable across different generation distributions. In addition, we introduce PAIR-IQ, a dataset tailored for training pairwise idea judgment models and serving as an auxiliary reference to support more objective comparative evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LigBench achieves stable and interpretable evaluations, significantly improving alignment with expert judgments. Furthermore, models trained on PAIR-IQ exhibit enhanced ranking accuracy and robustness, establishing a principled standard for scalable and objective research idea assessment.
articles.titleCn: LigBench：一个面向基于LLM的研究创意生成的统一且符合人类导向的基准
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，研究想法的生成吸引了越来越多的关注。现有方法使LLMs能够检索相关文献并为研究领域提出新颖的想法。然而，当前用于想法生成的评估实践仍然分散，缺乏客观标准，通常依赖于直接对LLMs进行评分，这限制了它们在生成想法的连贯分布中提供统一和可靠评估的能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了LigBench，一个自动化评估基准，它能够对不同生成分布进行细粒度和可靠的AI研究想法评估。此外，我们引入了PAIR-IQ，一个为训练成对想法判断模型而设计的特定数据集，并作为辅助参考支持更客观的比较评估。大量实验表明，LigBench实现了稳定且可解释的评估，显著提高了与专家判断的一致性。此外，在PAIR-IQ上训练的模型表现出更高的排序准确性和鲁棒性，为可扩展和客观的研究想法评估建立了一个原则性标准。

articles.title: CASA: Content-Acoustic Speaking Assessment with Speech Encoder and Large Language Model
articles.abstract: Research on automatic speaking assessment (ASA) has increasingly adopted multimodal speech large language models to assess learners' speaking performance. However, existing studies provide limited analysis of how acoustic and content information contribute to predictions and how stable the resulting performance is. We propose CASA, a simpler architecture combining Whisper-medium and Qwen3.5-2B that achieves state-of-the-art performance while providing a more interpretable separation between speech delivery and content. On the Speak & Improve Corpus 2025, CASA achieves a root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.358, improving on the previous best RMSE while using approximately half the estimated inference parameters. The general-purpose architecture is designed for adaptation to other ASA corpora without structural changes and relies on three handcrafted fluency features. Through ablations and repeated runs, we analyze the individual and complementary contributions of acoustic and content information, examine performance variability, and demonstrate the potential of large language model reasoning for training-free content validation.
articles.comment: To be submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code is available at https://github.com/aalto-speech/casa
articles.titleCn: CASA：基于语音编码器和大型语言模型的语音内容声学说话人评估
articles.abstractCn: 自动口语评估（ASA）的研究越来越多地采用多模态语音大型语言模型来评估学习者的口语表现。然而，现有研究对声学信息和内容信息如何贡献预测以及结果的稳定性分析有限。我们提出了CASA，一种结合了Whisper-medium和Qwen3.5-2B的更简单架构，它在实现最先进性能的同时，提供了更可解释的语音表达与内容之间的分离。在Speak & Improve Corpus 2025上，CASA实现了0.358的均方根误差（RMSE），优于之前的最佳RMSE，同时使用的推理参数估计量约为之前的一半。该通用架构设计用于无需结构变化即可适应其他ASA语料库，并依赖于三个手工制作的流利度特征。通过消融实验和重复运行，我们分析了声学信息和内容信息的单独及互补贡献，考察了性能的变异性，并展示了大型语言模型推理在无监督内容验证方面的潜力。

articles.title: Explanatory Engagement Under Rare Anomalous Failure: Asymptotic Rarity in Model Behavior (or: The Asymptotic AI)
articles.abstract: Prior work on LLM behavior under anomalous conditions asks whether a model notices anomalies. We ask a narrower question: once a model sits in a workflow with a low, controllable failure rate, does its explanatory engagement - length, specificity, self-reported confidence - change as failure grows asymptotically rarer? We built a local, zero-cost harness on three open-weight models (qwen3:8b, llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b) running a repeated tool-call task where one call fails at probability p, swept across eight rates from 0.2 to 0.0001, under five elicitation conditions from immediate prompting to none. We hypothesized a rise in engagement as failures grew rarer, then a collapse near a detectability threshold. Pooled across conditions this appeared false: length fell in a flat, monotonic pattern. Splitting by condition overturned that. Under immediate_forced, where the model must explain every failure instantly, the predicted rise is confirmed but followed by a plateau, not a collapse: length peaks at 28.4 words at p=0.05, settles to 17.4-19.0 words at the rarest rates, and confidence rises unevenly from about 53% to the 70s-90s. Under grouped_runs, explanation batched to run-end, no collapse appears. Under passive_unprompted, aggregate magnitude is a floor artifact, but a recovered logging gap revealed real, model-specific self-monitoring: llama3.1:8b volunteers structured confidence reports unprompted, sometimes eroding its own confidence as trials accumulate; the other two do so only once, as boilerplate. Elicitation structure is a first-class moderator of collapse observability. A companion guaranteed-failure run (72 cells, backfilling rates where random sampling gave zero real failures) shows models differ in whether they recognize an anomaly, distinct from engagement once recognized. Limitation: discrete rate points cannot capture behavior between them, a direction for future work.
articles.comment: 11 figures. Elicitation-condition sweep across three open-weight models (qwen3:8b, llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b); pipeline scripts and experimental data available upon reasonable request
articles.titleCn: 罕见异常故障下的解释性参与：模型行为的渐近稀有性（或：渐近式人工智能）
articles.abstractCn: 先前关于异常条件下大语言模型行为的研究探讨了模型是否能够注意到异常。我们提出一个更狭义的问题：当模型处于一个低且可控故障率的流程中时，随着故障逐渐变得罕见，其解释性参与度——长度、具体性、自我报告的置信度——是否会发生变化？我们构建了一个本地、零成本的测试框架，在三个开源权重模型（qwen3:8b、llama3.1:8b、mistral:7b）上运行重复工具调用任务，其中每次调用失败的概率为p，跨越了从0.2到0.0001的八个故障率，并在五种提示条件下进行测试，从即时提示到完全不提示。我们假设随着故障变得罕见，模型的参与度会上升，然后在可检测阈值附近崩溃。在所有条件下汇总的结果显示这是错误的：长度呈现平缓的、单调的模式下降。按条件划分的结果则推翻了这一结论。在即时强制条件下，模型必须立即解释每次故障，预测的上升得到了证实，但随后出现平台期而非崩溃：在p=0.05时，长度达到28.4个词的峰值，在故障率最罕见时稳定在17.4-19.0个词，置信度从约53%不均匀地上升到70s-90s。在分组运行条件下，解释被批量到运行结束时，没有出现崩溃。在被动非提示条件下，聚合幅度是地板效应的产物，但恢复的日志间隙揭示了真实的、模型特定的自我监控：llama3.1:8b会自愿提供结构化的置信度报告，有时随着试验累积而削弱其自身的置信度；其他两个模型仅在作为样板的情况下才这样做。提示结构是影响崩溃可观察性的首要调节因素。一个配套的保证故障运行（72个单元格，填补随机采样导致零个实际故障的故障率）表明，模型在是否识别异常方面存在差异，这与识别后的一致参与度不同。局限性：离散的故障率点无法捕捉它们之间的行为，这是一个未来工作的方向。

articles.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
articles.abstract: In expert-parallel (EP) MoE serving, every layer synchronizes at the slowest GPU. Dispatchers balance token counts (EPLB, LPLB, UltraEP) or activated-expert counts (METRO), assuming expert time is linear in one. Measurements on two datacenter GPU generations show it is neither: below $n^* \approx 156$--$168$ tokens, HBM weight streaming dominates---cost attaches to $activated replicas$, not tokens; above it, grouped GEMM rounds tokens to 128-tile $M$-tiles, so $splitting$ an expert adds padded compute. A max-affine profile $t=\max(a+bG,\,c+βN)$ captures both regimes. Realistic decode batches hold hot experts in the linear regime and cold in the flat $simultaneously$; recorded batches show proxy dispatches differ by $1.4$--$1.6\times$ in modeled block time (p95 up to $1.7\times$), and $which$ proxy wins flips with the regime. We formalize per-batch dispatch as a fixed-charge makespan problem---NP-hard on two fully replicated GPUs, polynomial in degenerate limits---and present TEMPO, a makespan-aware dispatcher solving it in milliseconds off the critical path; its SGLang integration runs out-of-process and fuses dispatch with count collection into one in-graph kernel. Anchored by an 8-GPU Testbed A microbenchmark, TEMPO stays within $1\%$ of the best fixed baseline everywhere and wins by up to $15.5\%$ where regimes mix. End-to-end on Testbed B, Qwen3-235B (inside the win region) gains $4$--$6\%$ throughput and cuts p99 latency by $\sim 15.6\%$; DeepSeek-V3 (outside, communication-dominated) shows only mechanism cost. A phase diagram, not a universal win, is the claim: it predicts both outcomes before deployment.

articles.titleCn: TEMPO：跨内存和计算受限模式的时延感知专家并行负载均衡
articles.abstractCn: 在专家并行（EP）MoE服务中，每一层都在最慢的GPU上同步。调度器平衡标记计数（EPLB、LPLB、UltraEP）或激活专家计数（METRO），假设专家时间与其中一个线性相关。对两个数据中心GPU代进行的测量表明，事实并非如此：低于$n^* \approx 156$--$168$个标记时，HBM权重流传输占主导地位——成本附加到激活副本上，而不是标记上；高于此值时，分组GEMM将标记舍入为128块$M$-块，因此拆分一个专家会增加填充计算。一个最大仿射配置$t=\max(a+bG,\,c+βN)$可以捕捉这两种状态。现实的解码批次在线性状态下持有热专家，在平坦状态下同时持有冷专家；记录的批次显示，代理调度在建模块时间内差异为$1.4$--$1.6\times$（p95高达$1.7\times$），并且哪种代理获胜会随着状态变化。我们将每批次的调度形式化为固定费用最短处理时间问题——在两个完全复制的GPU上为NP难，在退化极限内为多项式——并提出了TEMPO，一个考虑最短处理时间的调度器，它在非关键路径上以毫秒级时间解决该问题；其SGLang集成以进程外方式运行，并将调度与计数收集融合为单个图内核。基于一个8-GPU测试平台A的微基准测试，TEMPO在所有地方都保持在最佳固定基线的$1\%$以内，并在状态混合区域最高提升$15.5\%$。在测试平台B的端到端测试中，Qwen3-235B（在提升区域内）的吞吐量提升$4$--$6\%$，p99延迟降低$\sim 15.6\%$；DeepSeek-V3（在提升区域外，通信主导）仅显示机制成本。声称不是普遍的胜利，而是一个阶段图：它在部署前预测了这两种结果。

articles.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: Enabling agents to learn from experience and internalize it into their policy has become a central problem in self-evolving AI. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers an effective pathway by using a privileged self-teacher to provide dense supervision on the student's own trajectories; however, existing methods still rely heavily on designer-specified privileged artifacts (e.g., answers, feedback, skills, or trajectories), limiting the end-to-end learnability and scalability required for continual self-improvement. In this work, we introduce Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation (LOPD), which, rather than proposing another hand-crafted OPSD variant with a newly prescribed form of privileged context, makes the teacher's privileged context itself learnable end-to-end from experience. Technically, LOPD retrieves relevant experiences and composes them into continuous latent tokens that condition a self-teacher, while the student generates trajectories from the task and interaction history and receives dense token-level supervision at every visited prefix. We further introduce a privileged-margin objective to stabilize and regulate the learning of latent context. Empirically, LOPD demonstrates (I) strong performance, outperforming RLVR and representative OPSD methods including OPSD, SDPO, and Skill-SD across both agentic tool use and code generation; and (II) high learning efficiency, surpassing GRPO and Skill-SD with less than 30% of their rollout budget. Ablation studies further provide direct evidence that making privileged context learnable is necessary for realizing these gains. Together, these results position LOPD as a step toward a more scalable and self-directed paradigm for agent evolution.
articles.titleCn: 潜在策略自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 使智能体能够从经验中学习并将其内化为其策略已成为自进化人工智能的核心问题。策略内自我蒸馏（OPSD）通过使用特权自教师对学生自身的轨迹提供密集监督，提供了一种有效的途径；然而，现有方法仍然严重依赖设计者指定的特权工件（例如，答案、反馈、技能或轨迹），限制了端到端学习能力和可扩展性，这对于持续自我改进至关重要。在这项工作中，我们引入了潜在策略内自我蒸馏（LOPD），它并非提出另一种手工制作的OPSD变体，而是使教师的特权上下文本身能够从经验中端到端学习。技术上，LOPD检索相关经验并将其组合成连续的潜在标记来调节自教师，而学生根据任务和交互历史生成轨迹，并在每个访问的前缀处接收密集的标记级监督。我们进一步引入了特权边距目标，以稳定和规范潜在上下文的学习。实证上，LOPD展示了（I）优异的性能，在智能体工具使用和代码生成方面均优于RLVR和代表性的OPSD方法，包括OPSD、SDPO和Skill-SD；（II）高学习效率，以不到30%的部署预算超越了GRPO和Skill-SD。消融研究进一步提供了直接证据，证明使特权上下文可学习对于实现这些收益是必要的。总而言之，这些结果将LOPD定位为智能体进化向更可扩展和自导向范式迈进的一步。

articles.title: Class Imbalance and Batch Effects in LLM-Based Screening for Systematic Reviews
articles.abstract: This study analyses LLMs in imbalanced binary classification, using study screening in systematic reviews as the application domain. An experiment was conducted in five reviews, comparing individual and batch processing, with and without prevalence metadata. The results indicate a limited influence of the prevalence metadata, with no evidence that it improves performance. In contrast, batch processing produced larger behavioral changes that varied according to the prevalence of the class. The aggregate and item-level analyses did not always coincide. Therefore, batch processing should be evaluated not only in terms of cost, but also in relation to its effects on decision-making behavior.

articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的系统评价筛选中的类别不平衡和批次效应
articles.abstractCn: 本研究分析了在非平衡二分类问题中大型语言模型（LLMs）的应用，以系统评价中的研究筛选为应用领域。在五项评价中进行了实验，比较了单独处理和批量处理，以及有无患病率元数据的情况。结果表明患病率元数据的影响有限，没有证据表明它能提高性能。相比之下，批量处理产生了更大的行为变化，这些变化根据类别患病率而有所不同。汇总分析和项目级分析并不总是一致。因此，批量处理不仅应从成本角度进行评估，还应考虑其对决策行为的影响。

articles.title: RAGSieve: Self-Referenced Local Contrast for Knowledge-Poison Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation treats an external corpus as inference evidence, allowing injected documents to promote attacker-chosen claims. Existing detectors depend on trusted references, specific attack artifacts, or global thresholds sensitive to corpus topology. We present RAGSieve, a self-referenced detection framework that constructs its reference from the inspected system. RAGSieve-Query (RSQ) performs query-local contrast, scoring top-five candidates against ranks 6-20 of the same retrieval to detect answer-anchor concentration and carrier transitions. RAGSieve-Graph (RSG) performs corpus-local contrast, comparing each document's semantically similar but lexically distinct neighbors with its local baseline to detect coordinated density before queries arrive. Across three QA datasets and six poisoning constructions, RSQ achieves 95.2% AUROC and detects 82.2% of poison at 5% clean-document removal, versus 81.1%/52.5% for GMTP. RSG achieves 93.3%/79.8%, versus 79.4%/37.6% for CleanBase. Joint deployment reduces attack success from 67.4% to 14.0% while retaining 41.3% F1 on unpoisoned retrieval, demonstrating practical protection at both corpus ingestion and query time without poison labels or trusted corpora. Source code is available at https://github.com/XrazyMee/RAGSieve.
articles.titleCn: RAGSieve：检索增强生成中的知识中毒检测的自引用局部对比
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成将外部语料库视为推理证据，允许注入的文档推广攻击者选择的声明。现有的检测器依赖于可信参考、特定攻击痕迹或对语料库拓扑敏感的全局阈值。我们提出了RAGSieve，一个自引用的检测框架，它从被检查的系统构建其参考。RAGSieve-查询（RSQ）执行查询局部对比，对同一检索的排名前五的候选者与排名6-20的候选者进行评分，以检测答案锚定集中和载体转换。RAGSieve-图（RSG）执行语料库局部对比，将每个文档的语义相似但词汇不同的邻居与其局部基线进行比较，以检测查询到达前的协同密度。在三个问答数据集和六种中毒构造中，RSQ实现了95.2%的AUROC，并在5%的干净文档移除时检测到82.2%的中毒，而GMTP为81.1%/52.5%。RSG实现了93.3%/79.8%，而CleanBase为79.4%/37.6%。联合部署将攻击成功率从67.4%降低到14.0%，同时在不中毒检索上保留了41.3%的F1，展示了在语料库摄入和查询时间时的实际保护，而无需中毒标签或可信语料库。源代码可在https://github.com/XrazyMee/RAGSieve获取。

articles.title: EviReform: Evidence-Guided Query Reformulation for Multi-Hop Graph Retrieval
articles.abstract: Multi-hop retrieval must recover passages that provide sufficient evidence together. An initial passage often resolves an entity or relation implicit in the question, making the missing evidence easier to describe only after retrieval begins. Graph retrieval improves access to related evidence through stored corpus structure, but its retrieval signal is commonly derived from the original question. Complementary evidence must then be reached through stored relations even when an observed passage provides a more direct semantic cue. We introduce EviReform, which separates revising the retrieval request from aggregating evidence in the graph. Retrieved source passages formulate residual queries for the unresolved information need. The original and residual retrieval signals are normalized separately, combined, and propagated between propositions that share entities. On 2WikiMultiHopQA, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue, EviReform exceeds the strongest baseline by up to 5.59 Recall@5 points and 4.50 F1 points. These results show that observed evidence can guide graph retrieval toward the part of a supporting chain left underspecified by the original question. Code is available at https://github.com/XrazyMee/EviReform.
articles.titleCn: EviReform：用于多跳图检索的证据引导查询重写
articles.abstractCn: 多跳检索必须恢复提供充分证据的段落。初始段落通常解决问题中隐含的实体或关系，使得在检索开始后更容易描述缺失的证据。图检索通过存储的语料库结构提高了对相关证据的访问，但其检索信号通常源自原始问题。即使观察到的段落提供了更直接的语义线索，互补证据仍需通过存储的关系来获取。我们引入了EviReform，它将修改检索请求与在图中聚合证据分离。检索到的源段落为未解决的证据需求形成残余查询。原始检索信号和残余检索信号分别进行归一化、组合，并在共享实体的命题之间传播。在2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA和MuSiQue上，EviReform比最强的基线提高了高达5.59个Recall@5点和4.50个F1点。这些结果表明，观察到的证据可以引导图检索走向原始问题未能明确指定的支持链部分。代码可在https://github.com/XrazyMee/EviReform获取。

articles.title: HybridRAG-BN: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Fine-Tuned Verification for Bangla KBQA
articles.abstract: Knowledge-base question answering (KBQA) systems rely on effective retrieval and reasoning mechanisms to generate accurate answers from external knowledge sources. However, developing reliable KBQA systems for low-resource languages such as Bangla remains challenging due to limited retrieval-focused research, scarce language resources, and difficulties in grounding generated responses in external knowledge. In this work, we propose HybridRAG-BN, a retrieval-augmented framework for Bangla KBQA that integrates hybrid retrieval using BM25 and BGE-M3, answer generation using the GGUF version of Gemma-4-31B-Instruct, and a LoRA-fine-tuned Gemma-4-31B-Instruct model for answer verification and refinement. To further improve robustness, the framework incorporates a post-processing stage that addresses unresolved cases through fallback answer replacement and DuckDuckGo-assisted retrieval. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving token-level F1 scores of 0.71654 and 0.72912 on the public and private leaderboards, respectively, securing first place in the competition.

articles.titleCn: 混合RAG-BN：一种具有微调验证的检索增强型孟加拉语知识库问答框架
articles.abstractCn: 知识库问答（KBQA）系统依赖于有效的检索和推理机制，从外部知识源生成准确答案。然而，由于检索导向研究的局限性、语言资源的匮乏以及生成答案与外部知识结合的困难，为孟加拉语等低资源语言开发可靠的KBQA系统仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了HybridRAG-BN，这是一个用于孟加拉语KBQA的检索增强框架，集成了BM25和BGE-M3的混合检索、使用Gemma-4-31B-Instruct GGUF版本的答案生成，以及用于答案验证和细化的LoRA微调Gemma-4-31B-Instruct模型。为了进一步提高鲁棒性，该框架包含一个后处理阶段，通过备用答案替换和DuckDuckGo辅助检索来解决未解决的案例。实验结果表明，所提出的框架是有效的，在公开排行榜和私有排行榜上分别达到了0.71654和0.72912的token级F1分数，并在比赛中获得第一名。

articles.title: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation
articles.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents must preserve information from past interactions to support future tasks. Existing memory systems typically rely on eager consolidation, invoking LLMs after each interaction to extract, summarize, or update memories. This design makes memory construction increasingly costly as conversations grow. Coarse summarization can reduce construction cost but risks discarding fine-grained contextual evidence, whereas larger retrieval contexts or multi-hop LLM reasoning shift the overhead to query time. We present LycheeMemory V2, an efficient long-term memory framework that replaces turn-level consolidation with semantic segment-level consolidation. Instead of consolidating every interaction, LycheeMemory batches multiple exchanges into segments and encodes each finalized segment into context-independent typed memory records. Segment-level batching lowers LLM encoding frequency, while semantic boundary detection helps preserve coherent event-level and temporal evidence compared with fixed-window batching. The resulting records are organized with lightweight structured indexes for query-planned evidence retrieval. Experiments using GPT-4.1-Mini show that LycheeMemory achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 89.22% on LoCoMo and 92.20% on LongMemEval-S. Compared with A-Mem, it reduces construction tokens by 86.0% on LoCoMo and 75.9% on LongMemEval-S without increasing query-time token usage. More broadly, our results suggest that the accuracy--cost trade-off of long-term agent memory depends not only on what information is retained, but also on the granularity at which it is consolidated.
articles.titleCn: 荔枝记忆V2：通过语义分段级整合为LLM代理提供高效长期记忆
articles.abstractCn: 长时程大语言模型代理必须保留过去交互的信息以支持未来任务。现有的记忆系统通常依赖即时整合，在每次交互后调用大语言模型来提取、总结或更新记忆。这种设计使得记忆构建成本随着对话的增长而不断增加。粗略总结可以降低构建成本，但存在丢弃细粒度上下文证据的风险，而更大的检索上下文或多跳大语言模型推理则将开销转移到查询时间。我们提出了LycheeMemory V2，这是一个高效的长期记忆框架，它用语义片段级别的整合替代了回合级别的整合。LycheeMemory不是整合每次交互，而是将多次交互批量整合为片段，并将每个最终确定的片段编码为与上下文无关的带类型记忆记录。片段级别的批量处理降低了大语言模型编码频率，而语义边界检测有助于与固定窗口批量处理相比更好地保留连贯的事件级和时序证据。生成的记录通过轻量级结构化索引组织，用于查询计划的证据检索。使用GPT-4.1-Mini进行的实验表明，LycheeMemory达到了最先进的性能，在LoCoMo上达到89.22%，在LongMemEval-S上达到92.20%。与A-Mem相比，它在LoCoMo上减少了86.0%的构建token，在LongMemEval-S上减少了75.9%，而不会增加查询时间的token使用量。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，长期代理记忆的准确性与成本权衡不仅取决于保留的信息内容，还取决于整合的粒度。

articles.title: Reconcile Once, Write Anytime: A Trust-Tiered Librarian and a Multi-Agent Writer for Drift-Free, Point-in-Time Research
articles.abstract: Long-form research reports generated by large language models drift, contradict themselves, and lose provenance: the same metric appears with different values, and rumor is quoted as confidently as an audited filing. We present a two-tier agentic system that separates a maintained, point-in-time knowledge library from report writing. A deterministic "librarian" ingests timestamped sources into a trust-tiered ontology, layering evidence cards, an authoritative metric ledger, and a claim graph into an always-current source of truth, not per-query RAG over raw chunks. A portable multi-agent "writer" runtime then composes a contradiction-free, evidence-grounded report at any knowledge cutoff T, reading only evidence with as_of <= T (no look-ahead); red-team verdicts flow back into the librarian. We evaluate on a self-collected, public corpus of 6,130 sources yielding 555,926 evidence cards (SEC EDGAR filings across 295 issuers and 11 sectors, U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics releases, and Wikipedia). From the one library we compose four point-in-time reports on distinct theses and run eight reproducible experiments, whose headline metrics come from a deterministic quality-control gate, itself validated by defect-injection meta-evaluation at recall 1.0 and precision 1.0. A shared metric ledger removes 6,845 cross-section contradictions to zero. Tier-first selection is correct on 22/22 gold cases where a popularity-first baseline scores only 9/22; trust tiering leaks zero media-sourced numbers, and no government statistic displaces a company's own filing. A red-team refutation propagates back and self-corrects a later run with zero manual edits. Replay exhibits zero look-ahead violations across seven cutoffs while the library grows from 235,373 to 555,312 cards. Difficulty-tiered model routing exceeds the all-Opus quality ceiling while running 3.7x faster than serial.
articles.titleCn: 一次性协调，随时写作：一个信任级图书管理员和一个多智能体作家，用于无漂移、即时点研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型生成的长篇研究报告会出现漂移、自相矛盾且失去溯源：同一指标会出现不同数值，未经核实的传闻与经过审计的文件一样被引用。我们提出了一种双层代理系统，将维护中的时点知识库与报告撰写分离。一个确定性的"图书管理员"将带时间戳的来源摄入信任层级本体，将证据卡片、权威指标账本和声明图谱分层构建成一个始终更新的真相来源，而非针对原始数据块进行查询的RAG。一个可移植的多代理"写手"运行时则能在任何知识截止点T撰写无矛盾、有证据支撑的报告，仅读取截至时间T的证据（无前瞻性）；红队评估结果会反馈给图书管理员。我们在自收集的公开语料库上进行了评估，该语料库包含6,130个来源，生成555,926张证据卡片（涵盖295家发行商和11个行业的SEC EDGAR文件、美国劳工统计局发布的数据以及维基百科）。从同一知识库中，我们针对不同主题撰写了四个时点报告，并运行了八个可复现的实验，其核心指标来自一个确定性质量控制门，该门本身通过在召回率1.0和精确率1.0下的缺陷注入元评估得到验证。共享指标账本消除了6,845个跨截面矛盾，降至零。层级优先选择在22/22个黄金案例中正确，而流行度优先基线仅得9/22分；信任层级未泄露任何媒体来源的数字，且政府统计数据未取代公司自身文件。红队反驳会反向传播并自我纠正后续运行，无需零人工修改。重放测试在七个截止点中均无前瞻性违规，同时知识库从235,373张卡片增长至555,312张。难度层级模型路由超越了全Opus质量上限，同时运行速度比串行处理快3.7倍。

articles.title: Comment on "Modeling rapid language learning by distilling Bayesian priors into artificial neural networks"
articles.abstract: McCoy & Griffiths (2025, henceforth M&G) suggest that a Bayesian prior can be distilled into Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) through Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML, Finn et al., 2017). They support this empirically by showing that meta-trained networks demonstrate formal language learning abilities comparable to Yang & Piantadosi (2023)'s Bayesian learner, significantly outperforming standard ANNs. We point out that under the standard interpretation of a prior, M&G's procedure does not actually instill one; it merely initializes network weights favorably, leaving the objective function unchanged. We then consider a more permissive interpretation, where the system as a whole can be seen as implementing a Bayesian learner even without an explicit prior in the objective. We show that this interpretation faces nontrivial challenges. Finally, we assess how well MAML approximates the empirical results of Bayesian learning, showing that unlike genuine Bayesian learners, M&G's model overfits and generalizes poorly to unseen data.
articles.titleCn: "通过将贝叶斯先验知识蒸馏到人工神经网络中来实现快速语言学习"
articles.abstractCn: 麦科伊和格里菲斯（2025年，以下简称M&G）提出，贝叶斯先验可以通过模型无关元学习（MAML，Finn等人，2017年）提炼为人工神经网络（ANN）。他们通过实证研究支持这一观点，表明元训练的网络展现出与杨和皮亚纳多西（2023年）的贝叶斯学习器相当的形式语言学习能力，显著优于标准ANN。我们指出，在先验的标准解释下，M&G的方法实际上并未植入先验；它仅是优先初始化网络权重，而目标函数保持不变。随后，我们考虑一种更宽松的解释，即整个系统即使目标中不存在显式先验，也可以被视为实现了贝叶斯学习器。我们证明这种解释面临非平凡的挑战。最后，我们评估MAML逼近贝叶斯学习经验结果的程度，表明与真正的贝叶斯学习器不同，M&G的模型存在过拟合问题，且泛化能力差，难以处理未见数据。

articles.title: I-SDPO: Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) learns from reward differences within a rollout group, but receives no useful relative signal when every sampled response is incorrect. Privileged self-distillation can fill this gap with dense token supervision, yet applying it throughout training creates a different failure mode: the teacher is a biased, low-variance surrogate for the reward objective, so persistent imitation can oppose reward-improving updates after the policy becomes capable of producing successful trajectories. We introduce I-SDPO (Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization), which treats teacher reliance as capability-dependent. I-SDPO makes one routing decision per input instance and shares it across that instance's rollout group: all-incorrect groups use a privileged self-distillation objective, whereas any-success groups remain intact for GRPO. This design uses imitation only where group-relative rewards are uninformative. A local analysis characterizes when teacher and reward directions align and shows that a non-vanishing biased distillation weight induces an optimization bias floor. The routing rule automatically reduces the expected distillation rate as success probability rises, withdrawing teacher influence without a hand-designed schedule. On SciKnowEval, I-SDPO obtains the best result in all four scientific domains and improves average mean@16 accuracy from 56.67% with GRPO to 70.31%, with a maximum domain gain of 18.24 points.
articles.titleCn: 实例级自适应自蒸馏策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）从展开组内的奖励差异中学习，但在每个采样的响应都错误时无法获得有用的相对信号。特权自蒸馏可以填补这一空白，但将其在整个训练过程中应用会引发不同的失效模式：教师成为奖励目标的偏差、低方差替代，因此持续模仿会在策略能够产生成功轨迹后，反对奖励改进的更新。我们引入了实例级自适应自蒸馏策略优化（I-SDPO），将教师依赖视为与能力相关的。I-SDPO 对每个输入实例做出一次路由决策，并在该实例的展开组中共享该决策：全错组使用特权自蒸馏目标，而任何成功组则保持完整以供GRPO使用。这种设计仅在组相对奖励无信息时使用模仿。局部分析描述了教师和奖励方向一致的情况，并表明非消失的偏差蒸馏权重会导致优化偏差下限。路由规则会随着成功概率的上升自动降低预期蒸馏率，无需手动设计时间表。在SciKnowEval上，I-SDPO在所有四个科学领域均获得最佳结果，将平均mean@16准确率从GRPO的56.67%提高到70.31%，最大领域增益为18.24分。

articles.title: Unifying Depth and Width Pruning for LLMs via Binary Knapsack Optimization
articles.abstract: Structured pruning is a promising approach for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet existing methods rely heavily on greedy heuristics that produce myopic decisions, and often fail to precisely meet target compression budgets. We present SNIPER, a two-stage structured pruning framework that solves a knapsack optimization over coarse-granularity components to yield conditionally optimal parameter allocations with respect to fixed importance estimates, followed by a fine-grained pruning stage to meet strict budget constraints. We introduce the Compression Ratio Adherence Factor (CRAFT) to quantify budget fidelity, showing that while existing pruners deviate from target compression ratios by up to 33%, SNIPER achieves near-exact adherence with a CRAFT score of 0.98. Evaluations across four diverse architectures over a set of 18 tasks spanning five domains demonstrate SNIPER's consistent improvements in average performance retention and task-level stability over six state-of-the-art pruners. Across all pruning configurations, SNIPER achieves an excellent mean rank of 1.25, indicating its robust cross-architectural generalizability and excellent reliability.
articles.titleCn: 通过二进制背包优化统一LLMs的深度和宽度剪枝
articles.abstractCn: 结构化剪枝是一种压缩大型语言模型（LLM）的潜力方法，但现有方法严重依赖贪婪启发式算法，导致短视决策，且往往无法精确满足目标压缩预算。我们提出了SNIPER，一个两阶段结构化剪枝框架，它通过在粗粒度组件上解决背包优化问题，生成相对于固定重要性估计的条件最优参数分配，随后进行细粒度剪枝阶段以满足严格的预算约束。我们引入了压缩率遵循因子（CRAFT）来量化预算保真度，表明现有剪枝器与目标压缩率的偏差高达33%，而SNIPER以0.98的CRAFT分数实现了近乎精确的遵循。在涵盖五个领域的18项任务上对四种不同架构进行的评估表明，SNIPER在平均性能保留和任务级稳定性方面始终优于六种最先进的剪枝器。在所有剪枝配置中，SNIPER实现了1.25的优异平均排名，表明其跨架构泛化能力强且可靠性高。

articles.title: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding via Expert-Aligned Drafting
articles.abstract: Contrastive Decoding (CD) improves generation quality, but its amateur-model pass makes decoding expensive. Accelerating CD with speculative decoding raises a proposal-alignment question: should the contrastive signal shape the drafter, or should it remain only in verification? We study this question in the lightweight feature-level drafter regime. Two controlled diagnostics, matched Cross-alpha training and an Approximate Dual-Drafter decomposition, give the same diagnosis: contrastive-aware drafting does not consistently improve over expert-aligned drafting because the contrastive correction is usually weaker than drafter error, and reconstruction can amplify that error. We introduce Decoupled Contrastive Decoding (DCD), which drafts with an expert-aligned lightweight proposer and applies the amateur only in unchanged CD verification. Standard speculative verification preserves the vanilla-CD output distribution. Across the main 8B settings, EAGLE3-based DCD achieves average greedy speedups of 1.65 to 1.95x over vanilla CD and reduces MMLU proposal-path latency by about 5 to 12x relative to amateur-coupled proposal paths.
articles.titleCn: 基于专家对齐草稿的解耦对比解码
articles.abstractCn: 对比解码（CD）提升了生成质量，但其业余模型解码过程使解码成本高昂。通过推测性解码加速CD提出了一个提议-对齐问题：对比信号应塑造草稿者，还是应仅保留在验证阶段？我们在轻量级特征级草稿者模式下研究此问题。两种受控诊断方法——匹配交叉-Alpha训练和近似双重草稿者分解——给出了相同结论：对比感知草稿并未始终优于专家对齐草稿，因为对比校正通常弱于草稿者误差，且重建过程可能放大该误差。我们引入了解耦对比解码（DCD），该方案使用专家对齐的轻量级提议者进行草稿，仅在未更改的CD验证阶段使用业余模型。标准推测性验证保留了原味CD的输出分布。在主要的8B设置中，基于EAGLE3的DCD相较于原味CD实现了平均1.65至1.95倍的贪婪加速，并将MMLU提议路径延迟降低了约5至12倍，对比业余模型耦合的提议路径。

articles.title: Prompts in the Wild: A Large Analyzed Collection of Transactional Prompts in Code
articles.abstract: The behavior of contemporary generative Large Language Models (LLMs) is directly shaped by prompts, unstructured texts that describe the desired output and model behavior. In this paper we argue that prompts are linguistic objects that merit investigation in their own right. To this end, we collect 57.5K unique samples of prompts from GitHub. Specifically, we focus on transactional prompts: reproducible natural language instructions that are integrated into software. To enable the empirical, quantitative study of prompts, we introduce a structured ontology, capturing the properties of prompts as well as their formal and semantic components. Based on this ontology, we transform prompts from unstructured raw texts into richly structured linguistic objects. Analysis of these structured data reveals significant diversity of usage patterns across languages, domains, tasks, and modalities, in a typical Zipf-like distribution where some clearly prevail and others, more diverse, appear in the long tail. To validate the reliability of the ontology-based annotation of the prompts, we perform a comprehensive error analysis across all fields, providing a detailed assessment of annotation quality. We release the dataset together with a browsing and exploration interface (https://github.com/OnlpLab/transactionalPromptsCollection ).
articles.titleCn: 野外提示：一个大型分析交易提示代码集合
articles.abstractCn: 当代生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）的行为直接受到提示的影响，提示是指描述期望输出和模型行为的非结构化文本。在本文中，我们主张提示本身是值得研究的语言对象。为此，我们从GitHub收集了57.5K个独特的提示样本。具体而言，我们关注交易式提示：可重复的自然语言指令，这些指令被集成到软件中。为了实现对提示的实证、定量研究，我们引入了一个结构化本体，该本体捕捉了提示的属性及其形式和语义成分。基于这个本体，我们将提示从非结构化的原始文本转换为丰富的结构化语言对象。对这些结构化数据的分析揭示了跨语言、领域、任务和模态的显著使用模式多样性，呈现出典型的Zipf分布，其中一些模式明显占主导地位，而更多样化的模式则出现在长尾中。为了验证基于本体的提示标注的可靠性，我们对所有领域进行了全面的错误分析，提供了详细的标注质量评估。我们发布了数据集以及一个浏览和探索界面（https://github.com/OnlpLab/transactionalPromptsCollection）。

articles.title: BavGround: A Benchmark for Regional Cultural Grounding and Dialect Competence in Bavarian
articles.abstract: Cultural evaluation of large language models (LLMs) often focuses on high-resource standard languages, leaving regional culture and dialect communities underrepresented. We introduce BavGround, a benchmark for evaluating Bavarian regional cultural grounding and dialect competence across English, German and Bavarian. BavGround contains 206 multiple-choice source questions across eight cultural domains per language, yielding 618 multi-parallel instances, with items covering both broadly accessible cultural knowledge and source-grounded regional knowledge from journalism, historical sources, and specialist literature. We evaluate fifteen 7B-10B open-weight instruction-tuned models and one closed-model reference. Strong multilingual models perform best overall, but performance drops on Bavarian items and source-grounded questions, indicating persistent difficulty with dialectal and localized cultural knowledge. We further show that conclusions depend strongly on evaluation protocol: raw answer-letter scoring, shuffled-letter scoring, option-text likelihood, generated-answer parsing, and semantic matching can produce different absolute scores and rankings, especially for regionally adapted models. Finally, an exploratory analysis of GENBA-10B checkpoints suggests that continued pretraining improves answer-content likelihood unevenly across domains, while dialect competence remains comparatively weak. BavGround supports localized, protocol-aware evaluation of cultural representation in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: BavGround：巴伐利亚地区文化定位和方言能力基准
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLMs）的文化评估通常聚焦于高资源标准语言，导致区域文化和方言社群代表性不足。我们引入了BavGround，一个用于评估英语、德语和巴伐利亚语中巴伐利亚区域文化基础和方言能力的基准。BavGround包含每门语言八个文化领域中的206个多项选择题源问题，产生了618个多平行实例，其中项目涵盖了广泛可获取的文化知识和来自新闻、历史资料及专业文献的源基础区域知识。我们评估了十五个7B-10B开放权重指令微调模型和一个封闭模型参考。强多语言模型总体表现最佳，但在巴伐利亚语项目和源基础问题上的表现下降，表明在方言和本地化文化知识方面仍存在持续困难。我们进一步表明，结论强烈依赖于评估协议：原始答案字母评分、字母打乱评分、选项文本似然度、生成答案解析和语义匹配可能产生不同的绝对分数和排名，特别是对于区域适应模型。最后，对GENBA-10B检查点的探索性分析表明，持续的预训练改进了不同领域答案内容的似然度不均衡，而方言能力相对较弱。BavGround支持对LLMs中文化代表性进行本地化、协议感知的评估。

articles.title: When Your Agent Opens the Chat App: Agent-Controlled Search over Raw Chat Logs Rivals Structured Memory
articles.abstract: Agent-memory systems increasingly buy retrieval quality with structure, transforming raw conversation histories into summaries, embeddings, trees, or knowledge graphs before any question is asked. We ask how much of that benefit comes from the structure itself, rather than from competent retrieval over the raw history. We present ReFind, an agent-controlled search interface that builds no semantic structure at all: it leaves the conversation archive unmodified, indexes it lexically at turn granularity, and combines a generic iterative keyword-search loop with four chat-native controls grounded in empirical refinding work: session-aware rank fusion, local context expansion, temporal narrowing, and skipping already-inspected sessions. A separate reasoning stage answers from the collected evidence. Across a broad suite of conversational-memory tasks (single- and multi-hop QA, event ordering, and fact consolidation), roughly 2,800 questions on precise-retrieval and fact-tracking capabilities evaluated under the incremental multi-turn setting of MemoryAgentBench, ReFind attains the highest mean accuracy (58.2) of any system compared, above the strongest graph- and tree-based memory systems (HippoRAG 2, 53.2), all under a GPT-4o-mini backbone matched to every reused baseline. Controlled comparisons to single-shot BM25, a matched generic-agentic BM25 control, component removals, and agentic dense/hybrid variants separately support the roles of agent control, chat-native controls, and lexical retrieval. On LongMemEval-S/M, the same interface reaches 93.2 +/- 3.3 and 89.3 +/- 6.0 with GPT-5-mini. The results indicate that for precise, evidence-grounded questions over chat archives, much of the benefit credited to elaborate memory structures is recoverable by giving an agent controllable search over the unmodified record, with no LLM-based index construction at all.
articles.titleCn: 当您的代理打开聊天应用时：基于原始聊天记录的代理控制搜索与结构化记忆相媲美
articles.abstractCn: 代理-记忆系统越来越多地用结构牺牲检索质量，在提出任何问题之前将原始对话历史转化为摘要、嵌入、树或知识图谱。我们探究这些收益有多少来自结构本身，而非对原始历史的胜任检索。我们提出了ReFind，一个由代理控制的搜索界面，它完全不构建任何语义结构：它保留对话存档不变，以回合粒度进行词汇索引，并将通用的迭代关键词搜索循环与四种基于实证再发现工作的聊天原生控制相结合：会话感知的排名融合、本地上下文扩展、时间范围缩小以及跳过已检查的会话。一个单独的推理阶段根据收集的证据进行回答。在一系列广泛的对话记忆任务（单跳和多跳问答、事件排序和事实整合）中，在MemoryAgentBench的增量多回合设置下对精确检索和事实跟踪能力进行了约2,800个问题的评估，ReFind达到了所有比较系统中最高的平均准确率（58.2），高于最强的基于图和树的记忆系统（HippoRAG 2，53.2），所有系统均使用与每个重用的基线匹配的GPT-4o-mini主干。与单次BM25、匹配的通用代理BM25控制、组件移除以及代理密集/混合变体的受控比较分别支持了代理控制、聊天原生控制和词汇检索的作用。在LongMemEval-S/M上，相同的界面使用GPT-5-mini达到了93.2 +/- 3.3和89.3 +/- 6.0。结果表明，对于聊天存档上的精确、基于证据的问题，大部分归因于复杂记忆结构的收益可以通过让代理对未修改的记录进行可控搜索来恢复，而完全不需要基于LLM的索引构建。

articles.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
articles.abstract: Should you replace your text-embedding pipeline with a large language model? We answer this with a controlled, cost-aware comparison of ten LLMs across six families and 26 embedding models (118M to 14B parameters) on 37 tasks spanning classification, semantic textual similarity (STS), clustering, pair classification, and retrieval. In aggregate the two paradigms are effectively tied: the best LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro, 77.6) and the best embedding model (77.2) differ by 0.4 points. Their strengths differ by task: LLMs lead on reasoning-heavy retrieval, embedding models lead on classification, and the two match on clustering, STS, and pair classification. Reaching that parity is expensive. An LLM costs up to 1,431x more than an embedding model of comparable quality (USD 154 vs. USD 0.11 per benchmark pass), and the open LLMs tested process tokens 2.5 to 736x more slowly on the same GPU. Reasoning tokens account for 28 to 81% of LLM inference cost; lower reasoning budgets preserve or improve retrieval quality for most models in our ablation. The Pareto frontier contains the leading embedding models and one LLM, Gemini 3.1 Pro. These results support a division of labour: use embedding models for similarity, classification, and clustering, and reserve LLMs for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Our code, datasets, and results are publicly available at https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/embedders-dilemma.
articles.titleCn: 嵌入者的困境：大语言模型更好，但代价是什么？
articles.abstractCn: 您是否应该用大型语言模型替换您的文本嵌入流程？我们通过一项受控的、成本敏感的比较来回答这个问题，比较了跨越六个系列和26个嵌入模型（参数量从1.18亿到140亿不等）的十个LLM，在涵盖分类、语义文本相似性（STS）、聚类、配对分类和检索的37项任务上。总体而言，这两种范式效果相当：最佳LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro，得分77.6）和最佳嵌入模型（77.2）相差0.4分。它们的优势因任务而异：LLM在推理密集型检索任务上表现领先，嵌入模型在分类任务上表现领先，而在聚类、STS和配对分类任务上两者表现相当。达到这种均势的成本很高。同等质量的LLM成本高达嵌入模型的1431倍（每基准测试通过154美元与0.11美元），而测试中的开源LLM在相同GPU上处理token的速度慢2.5到736倍。推理token占LLM推理成本的28%到81%；在我们的消融实验中，较低的推理预算对大多数模型在检索质量上或保持或有所提升。帕累托前沿包含了领先的嵌入模型和一款LLM，Gemini 3.1 Pro。这些结果支持劳动分工：使用嵌入模型进行相似性、分类和聚类，并将LLM用于推理密集型检索。我们的代码、数据集和结果可在https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/embedders-dilemma公开获取。

articles.title: Falsehood and Impossibility Are Different Directions in an AI's Representation of Language
articles.abstract: Language can describe states of affairs that are false and states of affairs that could not be the case at all. Whether an AI model internally distinguishes these failures remains unclear. I report an exploratory activation study of the multimodal open-weight model Gemma 3 4B IT using 85 prompts from 17 philosophical families and a topic-matched modality set of 15 topics, each expressed as a truth, contingent falsehood, improbable claim, semantic anomaly, and necessary falsehood. In its answers, the model conflates contingent falsehood with contradiction, labeling 12 of 15 false statements "contradiction." Its activations show a different pattern. A linear truth probe separates impossible from true statements (AUC 0.93) but not impossible from false statements (AUC 0.20). An impossibility probe evaluated on held-out topic families separates necessary from contingent falsehood at AUC 1.00, peaking at layer 15 with balanced accuracy 0.97 (Bonferroni-adjusted P=0.018). The truth and impossibility directions are close to orthogonal, whereas the impossibility direction partially overlaps a semantic anomaly direction while remaining distinguishable from it. Sparse autoencoder features at the same layer repeat this geometry. Features selective for impossibility also fire on anomalous sentences but rarely on contingent falsehoods. In this model's activation space, necessary falsehoods are not extreme cases of contingent falsehood but lie closer to the experimentally defined category of semantic anomaly. This representational proximity does not imply that impossible statements are intrinsically meaningless. These correlational observations from one small model offer an empirical footnote to an old philosophical distinction.
articles.titleCn: 虚假与不可能在人工智能的语言表征中是不同的方向
articles.abstractCn: 语言能够描述虚假的情境以及根本不可能发生的情境。人工智能模型是否在内部区分这些失败尚不明确。我报告了一项探索性激活研究，研究对象是多模态开放权重模型Gemma 3 4B IT，该研究使用了来自17个哲学系列的85个提示，以及一个与主题匹配的模态集，包含15个主题，每个主题以真相、偶然虚假、不大可能的主张、语义异常和必然虚假的形式表达。在模型的回答中，它将偶然虚假与矛盾混淆，将15个虚假陈述中的12个标记为“矛盾”。其激活模式显示出不同的特征。线性真相探测能够区分不可能与真实的陈述（AUC 0.93），但不能区分不可能与虚假的陈述（AUC 0.20）。在保留的主题系列上评估的不可能性探测能够区分必然与偶然虚假（AUC 1.00），在层级15时达到峰值，平衡准确率为0.97（Bonferroni校正P=0.018）。真相方向与不可能方向接近正交，而不可能方向部分重叠于语义异常方向，但仍然可以与其区分。同一层级的稀疏自动编码器特征重复了这种几何结构。对不可能性具有选择性的特征也会在异常句子上激活，但在偶然虚假句子上很少激活。在这个模型的激活空间中，必然虚假并非偶然虚假的极端情况，而是更接近实验定义的语义异常类别。这种表征上的邻近性并不意味着不可能的陈述在本质上没有意义。这些来自一个小模型的关联性观察为古老的哲学区分提供了一个经验性的注脚。

articles.title: A Calibrated Test of Internal Action Maps: State Signals Without Global Affine Closure
articles.abstract: A hidden state signal can be decodable or causally usable without supporting a reusable action map. We test whether action maps fitted without a source reach its natural post-action activation and compose. We organize the tests as an evidence lattice and validate the geometric branch on a known affine S_5 carrier: all held-source folds pass one-step, composition, inverse, decoding, and commutativity gates. Structured curvature and held-domain conjugacy raise error monotonically, but only 23/30 strongest cells flip a closure gate, bounding rather than universalizing calibration. In post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-4B, frozen final-token h28 affine maps have mean held-entity error .519, versus .398 for within-test-domain cross-fit. Seven randomized entity splits and map geometry do not support a purely entity-specific account. Earlier h4/h16 layers fit one-step transitions better, but h4 conflict-state decoding is weak and lexical controls remain unresolved. Three matched intervention datasets regenerated from one frozen checkpoint show causal effects only at h28/h36. Outcome-aware refitting improves h28 one-step error to .474 (.469 with weighting), yet no refit passes composition. Learned finite worlds likewise preserve relative algebraic signals or shared charts without held-source affine closure. Within the tested carriers, state availability, causal use, local geometry, and reusable closure are separable. The result is limited to one pretrained model, sampled final-token layers, two finite worlds, and the tested affine or diagnostic function classes.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; includes supplementary results and ancillary reproducibility files
articles.titleCn: 内部动作地图的校准测试：无全局仿射闭包的状态信号
articles.abstractCn: 隐藏状态信号可以在不支持可重用动作映射的情况下实现可解码性或因果可用性。我们测试了在无源情况下拟合的动作映射是否能够达到其自然后动作激活和组合，并将测试组织为一个证据格网，在已知的仿射S_5载体上验证了几何分支：所有持有源的折叠都通过了一步、组合、逆、解码和交换性门。结构化曲率和持有域共轭单调增加误差，但只有23/30最强的单元翻转了闭包门，从而限制了校准的普遍性而非普遍化。在预训练的Qwen/Qwen3-4B中，冻结的最终标记h28仿射映射的平均持有实体误差为0.519，而在测试域内交叉拟合的误差为0.398。七个随机化的实体分割和映射几何不支持纯粹的实体特定解释。较早的h4/h16层更适合拟合一步转换，但h4冲突状态解码较弱，词汇控制仍未解决。三个从单个冻结检查点重新生成的匹配干预数据集仅在h28/h36处显示因果效应。结果感知的再拟合将h28一步误差改进为0.474（加权后为0.469），但没有任何再拟合通过组合。学习的有限世界同样保留了相对代数信号或共享图表，而无需持有源仿射闭包。在测试的载体中，状态可用性、因果使用、局部几何和可重用闭包是可分离的。该结果仅限于一个预训练模型、采样的最终标记层、两个有限世界以及测试的仿射或诊断函数类。

articles.title: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
articles.abstract: Retrieval can identify a past trajectory that may matter, yet it does not specify how an acting agent should use that trajectory after users, entities, constraints, or environment state have changed. We identify this post-retrieval reuse step as a distinct bottleneck for long-horizon trajectory memory and formulate an evaluation framework that holds candidate retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget fixed while varying the support delivered to the agent. We instantiate the framework with query-conditioned reuse (QCR), a deliberately simple target-bound note that records a reusable procedure, bindings to recover, applicability conditions, and verification requirements. QCR serves to test the reuse hypothesis rather than to claim a universally preferred memory format. Across 2,391 target instances in WebArena, WorkArena, and AppWorld, QCR reaches 62.3% average Success, 10.7 points above Full Trajectory, while using 48.9% fewer online tokens. Summary reranking selects a reusable memory for 94.8% of targets, placing end-task Success within 1.8 points of an oracle reusable selector. Analyses by trajectory length and source--target binding shift show that direct trajectory injection loses much of its utility as traces grow longer or source-specific values change, whereas target-bound support preserves a larger share of the measured gain. The resulting framework separates retrieval quality from the problem of turning retrieved experience into safe, useful support for a new task.
articles.titleCn: 超越检索：基于查询条件的长期视野智能体轨迹重用
articles.abstractCn: 检索可以识别一个可能重要的过去轨迹，但它并未指明在用户、实体、约束或环境状态发生变化后，行动代理应如何使用该轨迹。我们将检索后的重用步骤识别为长期轨迹记忆的一个独特瓶颈，并构建了一个评估框架，该框架将候选检索、目标状态、模型、解码和工具预算固定，同时改变提供给代理的支持。我们使用查询条件重用（QCR）实例化该框架，QCR是一个故意设计的、以目标为导向的笔记，记录了可重用程序、恢复绑定、适用条件和验证要求。QCR旨在测试重用假设，而非声称一种普遍偏好的记忆格式。在WebArena、WorkArena和AppWorld中的2,391个目标实例中，QCR达到62.3%的平均成功率，比全轨迹高10.7个百分点，同时使用48.9%更少的在线令牌。摘要重排序为94.8%的目标选择了可重用记忆，将最终任务成功率与可预测的可重用选择器仅相差1.8个百分点。轨迹长度和源-目标绑定变化的分析表明，随着轨迹变长或源特定值变化，直接轨迹注入会失去大部分效用，而目标绑定支持则保留了更大一部分测量到的收益。由此产生的框架将检索质量与将检索到的经验转化为对新任务的安全、有用支持的问题分离开来。

articles.title: AQuA: Recursively Self-Improving Quantitative Trading Research Agents
articles.abstract: We study recursive self-improvement at the level of quantitative-investment research: whether an autonomous system can use evidence from earlier experiments to improve the hypotheses and candidates proposed in later iterations. We present AQuA, which comprises two separate language-model-driven research systems: one for symbolic factor discovery and one for trainable model development. The two systems do not share agents, memories, candidate spaces, or research state. Instead, each independently closes its own research loop by retaining validated evidence and using it to guide subsequent proposals. In this bounded sense, both systems implement recursive self-improvement at the level of the research process. Each system also uses its own sealed sandbox, which fixes the data splits, feature and label definitions, and evaluator while allowing the model to act only through constrained factor expressions or configuration diffs. The factor system, a manager-mediated multi-agent pipeline, discovers and combines factors into a signal that reaches a combined information coefficient of about $0.190$ on a crypto universe. The model system, a config-driven loop over a hybrid time-series architecture, reaches a per-stock information coefficient of $+0.0843$ on US equities and converts it into a threshold long/short strategy with a held-out Sharpe of up to $+2.50$ at a two-leg cost. The strategy is positive in every year from 2021 to 2025.
articles.titleCn: AQuA：递归自我改进的量化交易研究智能体
articles.abstractCn: 我们在量化投资研究层面研究递归自我改进：一个自主系统是否能够利用早期实验的证据来改进后期迭代中提出的假设和候选方案。我们提出了AQuA，它包含两个独立的、由语言模型驱动的科研系统：一个用于符号因子发现，另一个用于可训练模型开发。这两个系统不共享代理、记忆、候选空间或科研状态。相反，每个系统通过保留验证过的证据并利用它来指导后续提案，独立地闭合自己的科研闭环。在这个有界意义上，这两个系统都在科研过程中实现了递归自我改进。每个系统还使用自己的封闭沙盒，它固定了数据划分、特征和标签定义以及评估器，同时仅允许模型通过受限因子表达式或配置差异来行动。因子系统是一个由管理者介导的多代理管道，它发现并组合因子，形成一个信号，在加密宇宙上达到约0.190的综合信息系数。模型系统是一个基于配置的混合时间序列架构循环，在美国股票上达到每只股票+0.0843的信息系数，并将其转化为一个持有成本为两腿成本的阈值多空策略，其回测夏普比率高达+2.50。该策略在2021年至2025年的每一年都是正的。

articles.title: From Atomic Evidence to Logical Composition: Structured Compositional Reasoning over Compound Answer Options
articles.abstract: Large language models often fail when answer options require combining atomic judgments under explicit logical operators, even when they judge the individual atoms correctly. We study compound options connected by AND, OR, and NEITHER/NOR, introducing a framework that decomposes each option into atomic answers and scores contrastive hypotheses about each one, so the model never sees a compound option. An operator-constrained integer linear program then composes the calibrated scores into a single prediction. We evaluate on LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA and introduce LOGICAL-SATA, a reading-comprehension benchmark derived from SATA-Bench. Our framework improves Macro-F1 from 48.3 to 77.0 on the human-validated LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA split and from 47.0 to 75.6 on LOGICAL-SATA, with the largest gains on NEITHER/NOR.
articles.titleCn: 从原子证据到逻辑组合：关于复合答案选项的结构化组合推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在需要结合原子判断并使用明确逻辑运算符的答案选项时，往往表现不佳，即使它们能正确判断每个原子。我们研究了由AND、OR和NEITHER/NOR连接的复合选项，引入了一个框架，将每个选项分解为原子答案，并对每个原子提出对比假设进行评分，从而模型永远不会看到复合选项。然后使用运算符约束的整数线性规划将校准的分数组合为单一预测。我们在LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA上进行了评估，并引入了LOGICAL-SATA，这是一个从SATA-Bench衍生出的阅读理解基准。我们的框架在人类验证的LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA拆分上将Macro-F1从48.3提高到77.0，在LOGICAL-SATA上将Macro-F1从47.0提高到75.6，其中NEITHER/NOR的增益最大。

articles.title: FastThaiG2P: Lightning-fast Thai Grapheme-to-phoneme Conversion for Voice Agent Pipelines
articles.abstract: FastThaiG2P provides sub-millisecond Thai grapheme-to-phoneme conversion for text-to-speech pipelines (International Phonetic Alphabet and Kokoro-TTS conventions) using a PyThaiNLP-tokenized, extensible dictionary and normalization rules for common Central Thai speech. The approach achieves an average latency of 0.15 ms per utterance on a benchmark of 27,242 synthetically generated utterances, of which 30\% is spent on tokenization, 12\% on normalization, and 58\% on out-of-vocabulary fallbacks (0.5\% OOV rate). To demonstrate its effectiveness, we used FastThaiG2P to phonemize Som-TTS, an open dataset containing 20 hours of grapheme-and-audio pairs, then trained an 82M-parameter StyleTTS 2 model based on a Kokoro-TTS recipe. The resulting model vocalizes intelligible Thai speech suitable for prototyping and development at 0.25 real-time factor (4x real-time) with ONNX inference on CPU.
articles.titleCn: FastThaiG2P：为语音代理管道提供极速泰语字素到音素转换
articles.abstractCn: FastThaiG2P为文本到语音流程（国际音标和Kokoro-TTS规范）提供亚毫秒级的泰语字素到音素转换，采用PyThaiNLP分词的可扩展词典和常见中部泰语语音的规范化规则。该方法在27,242个合成生成的语句基准测试中，平均延迟为每语句0.15毫秒，其中30%用于分词，12%用于规范化，58%用于词汇外回退（0.5%的OOV率）。为展示其有效性，我们使用FastThaiG2P对Som-TTS（一个包含20小时字素-音频对的开放数据集）进行音素化，然后基于Kokoro-TTS配方训练了一个82M参数的StyleTTS 2模型。生成的模型在CPU上使用ONNX推理，以0.25实时因子（4倍实时）发出清晰的泰语语音，适用于原型设计和开发。

articles.title: CRAFT: LLM-Based Iterative Refinement for Temporal Reasoning over Clinical Narratives
articles.abstract: Understanding the temporal progression of symptoms in clinical narratives is critical for disease monitoring, safety surveillance, and causality assessment. Clinical narratives, however, rarely provide explicit temporal anchors. Current approaches to temporal information reasoning focus predominantly on pairwise relation classification across multi-visit and timestamp-rich records, leaving the reconstruction of structured symptom trajectories from individual anchor-sparse reports largely unaddressed. We propose CRAFT, an LLM framework that pairs a generator with a constraint-based verifier to iteratively produce and refine stage-wise symptom timelines through targeted feedback. We conduct evaluation on MedTempo, a new benchmark of 5,347 vaccine adverse-event narratives spanning three COVID-19 vaccine types, with expert-validated temporal stage annotations for 3,166 reports. Experiments across four LLM backbones demonstrate that CRAFT consistently improves temporal ordering accuracy, with ablation analysis isolating the contribution of generator and verifier components across model capability levels.
articles.titleCn: CRAFT：基于大型语言模型的临床叙事时间推理迭代优化
articles.abstractCn: 理解临床叙述中症状的时间进程对于疾病监测、安全监测和因果关系评估至关重要。然而，临床叙述很少提供明确的时间锚点。当前的时间信息推理方法主要集中于跨多就诊和富含时间戳记录的成对关系分类，而个体锚点稀疏报告的结构化症状轨迹重建则基本未得到解决。我们提出了CRAFT，这是一个将生成器与基于约束的验证器配对的LLM框架，通过目标反馈迭代生成和细化分阶段的症状时间线。我们在MedTempo上进行了评估，这是一个包含5,347份疫苗不良事件叙述的新基准，涵盖三种COVID-19疫苗类型，其中3,166份报告具有专家验证的时间阶段标注。跨四种LLM主干的实验表明，CRAFT始终提高了时间排序的准确性，而消融分析则隔离了生成器和验证器组件在不同模型能力水平上的贡献。

articles.title: ViTOED: A Dataset for Target-Oriented Emotion Detection on Vietnamese Social Media Texts
articles.abstract: This paper introduces ViTOED, a novel dataset for target-oriented emotion detection in Vietnamese social media texts. The ViTOED comprises 10,985 user comments and 21,244 manually annotated opinion quadruples (source, target, expression, polarity) that follow strict guidelines. The dataset reveals Vietnamese-specific phenomena, such as implicit sources and targets and vocabulary ambiguities, enabling deeper analysis of user emotions toward entities. We propose a baseline using structured sentiment graphs and evaluate various Vietnamese pre-trained language models. The empirical results highlight challenges in span detection and relation extraction and indicate substantial room for model improvement in Vietnamese Target-Oriented Emotion Detection tasks.

articles.titleCn: ViTOED：面向越南社交媒体文本的目标导向情绪检测数据集
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了一种名为ViTOED的新型数据集，用于越南社交媒体文本中的目标导向情绪检测。ViTOED包含10,985条用户评论和21,244个遵循严格指南的手动标注意见四元组（来源、目标、表达、极性）。该数据集揭示了越南特有的现象，如隐含的来源和目标以及词汇歧义，从而能够更深入地分析用户对实体的情绪。我们提出了一种基于结构化情感图的方法，并评估了各种越南预训练语言模型。实证结果表明，在跨度检测和关系抽取方面存在挑战，并表明在越南目标导向情绪检测任务中，模型有巨大的改进空间。

articles.title: Measuring Fairness in Large Audio Language Models via Semantic-Aware Bias Estimation
articles.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have seen increasing use for audio understanding tasks such as speech recognition and audio question answering, raising concerns about fairness across demographic subgroups. Fairness evaluation in spoken-input settings is challenging due to confounding factors, including semantic variation in spoken content and speaker-specific characteristics. Ignoring these factors can result in misleading conclusions about model bias. We propose a semantic-aware mixed-effects regression framework for fairness evaluation in LALMs that explicitly accounts for these confounders. Our approach incorporates sentence-level semantic embeddings of reference text as covariates and models speaker identity as a random effect. Notably, semantic representations are extracted from the same LALM under evaluation, enabling semantic control over variation as perceived by the model itself. Experiments on simulated data and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially reduces spurious fairness findings and yields more robust and interpretable estimates of subgroup performance differences.
articles.titleCn: 通过语义感知偏差估计在大规模音频语言模型中衡量公平性
articles.abstractCn: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在语音识别和音频问答等音频理解任务中的应用日益广泛，引发了关于不同人口子群体间公平性的担忧。由于存在混杂因素，如口语内容中的语义变化和特定说话人的特征，在口语输入环境下进行公平性评估具有挑战性。忽视这些因素可能导致对模型偏见的误导性结论。我们提出了一种语义感知混合效应回归框架，用于评估LALMs的公平性，该框架明确考虑了这些混杂因素。我们的方法将参考文本的句子级语义嵌入作为协变量，并将说话人身份建模为随机效应。值得注意的是，语义表示是从被评估的同一LALM中提取的，从而能够在模型自身感知的层面上对变化进行语义控制。在模拟数据和真实世界基准上的实验表明，所提出的方法显著减少了虚假的公平性发现，并产生了更稳健和可解释的子群体性能差异估计。

articles.title: ReconSpan: Reconstruction-Guided Adaptive Latent Tokenization
articles.abstract: Adaptive latent tokenization maps a fine-grained input to a shorter sequence of continuous representations associated with input-dependent spans. We introduce ReconSpan, which divides text into chunks that a backward decoder can reconstruct from a single contextual prefix code and retains one such code as the latent token for each chunk. The reconstruction criterion is applied when chunks are formed, allowing one trained autoencoder to produce average chunk lengths from 6.5 to 12.2. At matched average length, reconstruction-guided boundaries preserve more text than random boundaries. Readers of the resulting latent sequence recover topic information reliably but struggle to extract exact details.
articles.titleCn: ReconSpan：基于重建引导的自适应潜在标记化
articles.abstractCn: 自适应潜在标记化将细粒度输入映射为与输入相关联的连续表示的较短序列。我们引入了ReconSpan，它将文本分割成块，这些块可以被反向解码器从单个上下文前缀码中重建，并为每个块保留一个这样的码作为潜在标记。在块形成时应用重建标准，允许一个训练好的自动编码器产生从6.5到12.2的平均块长度。在匹配的平均长度下，重建引导的边界比随机边界保留更多文本。结果潜在序列的读者可以可靠地恢复主题信息，但在提取精确细节方面存在困难。

articles.title: PatientAct: Theory-Grounded Mental Health Client Simulation
articles.abstract: LLM-based simulated clients are increasingly used to train novice counselors, evaluate LLM therapists, and generate synthetic data. However, current simulators produce overly cooperative clients that disclose too readily, accept therapeutic reframes without resistance, and resolve core issues within a single session. We trace these issues to profiles that lack causal depth and behavioral mechanisms that treat all content as equally accessible. We present PatientAct, a framework for client simulation grounded in established clinical theories. Our profiles integrate the 5Ps clinical case formulation, providing causal depth without tying the design to any single therapeutic modality. During simulation, profiles include a dynamic memory layer in which items carry trust thresholds (e.g., symptoms are available early, whereas formative memories require a sustained therapeutic alliance). At each turn, the client's emotional reaction and behavior are modeled before generating a response. If the therapist approaches gated content, PatientAct expresses resistance in terms of quantity, content, and style rather than defaulting to cooperation or a single resistance pattern. We evaluate our framework on 40 clinical situations and demonstrate that it generates diverse profiles with high clinical plausibility. Moreover, PatientAct significantly outperforms the baselines, yielding substantial gains in resistance quality and behavioral realism. Our code and data will be publicly available via github.com/Sahandfer/PatientHub.
articles.titleCn: 患者行为模拟：基于理论的心理健康客户模拟
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的模拟客户正越来越多地用于培训新手咨询师、评估LLM治疗师以及生成合成数据。然而，当前的模拟器生成的客户过于配合，容易透露信息，无条件接受治疗性重构，并在单次会话中解决核心问题。我们将这些问题归因于缺乏因果深度和行为机制，这些机制将所有内容视为同等可获取的配置文件。我们提出了PatientAct，这是一个基于已确立临床理论的客户模拟框架。我们的配置文件集成了5Ps临床病例构建，提供了因果深度，但并未将其设计与任何单一的治疗模式绑定。在模拟过程中，配置文件包含一个动态记忆层，其中项目携带信任阈值（例如，症状早期即可获取，而形成性记忆则需要持续的治疗联盟）。在每次交互中，在生成回应之前，会模拟客户的情绪反应和行为。如果治疗师接近受保护的内容，PatientAct会以数量、内容和风格的方式表达阻力，而不是默认配合或单一阻力模式。我们在40个临床情境中评估了我们的框架，并证明它生成了具有高度临床可信度的多样化配置文件。此外，PatientAct显著优于基线，在阻力质量和行为真实性方面取得了巨大进步。我们的代码和数据将通过github.com/Sahandfer/PatientHub公开发布。

articles.title: Dual-Stream Cross-Anchor Correction Grounding Long-Form Captions and the Domain Limits of Object-Level Anchors
articles.abstract: Object hallucination in multimodal large language models arises when language priors and corpus co-occurrence bias outweigh the visual evidence, with nothing tying an object mention to the image. Most remedies intervene at decoding time, yet under a unified protocol their benefit is confined to short captions; supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a detail-rich corpus lengthens captions, but over forty percent still name absent objects. This paper proposes Dual-Stream Cross-Anchor Correction (DSCC). Unlike work that post-processes decoding, DSCC injects object-level visual anchors into the language model itself during fine-tuning: a perception stream aligns object-level hidden states at an intermediate layer to frozen text anchors by a bidirectional contrastive objective; a cognition stream lets deeper layers query those anchors by cross-attention at every generation step; and a two-stage curriculum gate couples them, making evidence retrieval a structural constraint on generation. Under one backbone and one scoring protocol, experiments span long-caption hallucination, object-existence discrimination and cross-domain generalisation, with vanilla SFT on the same corpus and schedule as a length- and density-matched control separating the data effect from the architectural gain. DSCC alone reaches the long-caption, low-hallucination region: captions roughly 1.9 times the baseline length at 88.19% precision per object mention, the highest under a density-independent criterion. Ablations expose a synergy: the perception stream alone degrades precision yet reverses sign when stacked on the cognition stream. No universal superiority is claimed: three out-of-domain benchmarks yield a predictable, falsifiable domain-conditionality, the synergy being bound to the anchors' semantic domain and breaking on charts and illusions.
articles.titleCn: 双流交叉锚点校正：长文本描述与对象级锚点的领域限制
articles.abstractCn: 在多模态大型语言模型中，对象幻觉的产生源于语言先验和语料库共现偏差超过了视觉证据，且没有任何内容将对象提及与图像关联起来。大多数补救措施在解码时介入，但在统一协议下，其效果仅限于简短字幕；在细节丰富的语料库上进行监督微调（SFT）可以延长字幕，但仍有超过百分之四十的字幕提及了不存在的对象。本文提出了双流交叉锚点校正（DSCC）。与在解码后进行后处理的现有工作不同，DSCC在微调过程中将对象级别的视觉锚点注入语言模型本身：感知流通过双向对比目标将对象级别的隐藏状态在中间层与冻结文本锚点对齐；认知流让更深层的网络在每个生成步骤通过交叉注意力查询这些锚点；一个两阶段课程门控将它们耦合，使证据检索成为生成过程中的结构约束。在一套骨干网络和一个评分协议下，实验涵盖了长字幕幻觉、对象存在性辨别和跨领域泛化，并将同一语料库和调度下的基础SFT作为长度和密度匹配的控制组，以区分数据效应与架构增益。仅DSCC就能达到长字幕低幻觉区域：在88.19%的每对象提及精度下，字幕长度约为基线的1.9倍，在密度无关标准下精度最高。消融实验揭示了协同效应：仅感知流会降低精度，但当叠加在认知流上时，精度会逆转。不声称普遍优越性：三个跨领域基准产生了可预测、可证伪的领域条件性，协同效应仅限于锚点的语义领域，在图表和错觉上失效。

articles.title: ERSkill: Evolving for Skill-Guided Adaptive Memory Retrieval
articles.abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory for persistent interactions, the retrieval mechanisms governing this memory are rarely treated as evolvable components. This static approach limits performance on heterogeneous memory queries, which often demand diverse evidence construction strategies. To address this, we introduce \textbf{ERSkill}, a retrieval-centric framework for self-evolving, skill-guided memory access. ERSkill compiles interaction histories into a structured memory store and represents retrieval behaviors as executable skills composed of fundamental primitives. At inference time, a trained router dynamically matches each query to the optimal skill to construct tailored evidence for answer generation. To enable continuous improvement, ERSkill co-evolves the skill set and the router during training. It employs an experience trie to efficiently record explored retrieval paths, alongside a double-frontier mechanism that safely decouples the expansion of new skill capabilities from stable, router-facing deployment. Experiments across multiple agent memory benchmarks demonstrate that ERSkill substantially outperforms strong non-evolving and self-evolving baselines. Notably, it improves the overall average across F1, BLEU-1, and LLM-judge scores by 31.3\% with Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct and by 28.1\% with GPT-5.4-nano.
articles.titleCn: ERSkill：为技能引导自适应记忆检索而进化
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地依赖长期记忆来支持持续性交互，控制这种记忆的检索机制却很少被视为可进化的组件。这种静态方法限制了在异构记忆查询上的性能，而这类查询往往需要多样化的证据构建策略。为解决这一问题，我们引入了\textbf{ERSkill}，这是一个以检索为中心、自我进化、技能引导的记忆访问框架。ERSkill将交互历史编译为结构化记忆存储，并将检索行为表示为由基本原语组成的可执行技能。在推理时，训练好的路由器会动态地将每个查询匹配到最优技能，以构建定制的证据用于答案生成。为实现持续改进，ERSkill在训练过程中协同进化技能集和路由器。它采用经验树形结构高效记录探索过的检索路径，同时结合双边界机制，安全地将新技能能力的扩展与稳定、面向路由器的部署解耦。在多个代理记忆基准测试中，实验结果表明ERSkill显著优于强大的非进化和自我进化基线模型。值得注意的是，使用Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct时，它在F1、BLEU-1和LLM-judge分数上的平均提升达到了31.3%；使用GPT-5.4-nano时，平均提升为28.1%。

articles.title: Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping (PRISM): naming-error dissociations in language models and post-stroke aphasia
articles.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability of large language models lacks spatially resolved, falsifiable tools for testing whether internal components are specialized for distinct cognitive operations. We adapt subtraction analysis, the standard framework of human neuroimaging, from biological brains to perturbed transformers, and apply the same logic to both substrates in parallel. Building on the Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM), which showed that layer-perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B error profiles match the lesion patterns of aphasic patients, we develop PRISM (Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping). PRISM maps the seven clinical Philadelphia Naming Test categories, subtracts error classes pairwise, and treats each perturbation seed as a subject in a group analysis with threshold-free cluster enhancement along the layer axis. We run a structurally matched analysis on 213 chronic post-stroke aphasia patients using correlation-difference lesion-symptom mapping, and replicate both sides on held-out splits. The designs match in subject dimension (seeds, patients), spatial dimension (layers, atlas-parcellated cortex) and thresholding, but the contrast operator differs: a within-subject error-proportion difference for the LLM, a between-subject correlation difference for the cortex. Both substrates recover a robust phonemic-favoring dissociation, a deep layer cluster and a frontal-perisylvian cortical cluster, both replicating; the semantic-favoring direction is a consistently signed but non-significant trend on both. PRISM thus gives a falsifiable, spatially resolved test of functional-specialization claims in transformer language models. A confirmatory ROI-level intervention (PRISM Stage 3) licensing the strongest causal-mechanism claim is left to subsequent work.

articles.titleCn: 基于扰动的区域可解释性通过减法映射（PRISM）：语言模型中的命名错误解离与中风后失语症
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的机制可解释性缺乏用于测试其内部组件是否专门针对不同认知操作的空间分辨、可证伪的工具。我们从生物大脑中借鉴人类神经影像学的标准框架——减法分析，并将其应用于扰动型转换器，并行地应用相同的逻辑于两种基质。基于脑-语言模型统一模型（BLUM），该模型表明层扰动LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B的错误模式与失语症患者的病灶模式相匹配，我们开发了扰动驱动的区域可解释性通过减法映射（PRISM）。PRISM映射了七种临床费城命名测试类别，成对地减去错误类别，并将每个扰动种子视为群体分析中的受试者，沿层轴进行无阈值聚类增强。我们使用相关性差异病灶-症状映射，对213名慢性中风后失语症患者进行结构匹配分析，并在保留的分割数据上重复验证了两侧结果。设计在受试者维度（种子、患者）、空间维度（层、图谱分区的皮质）和阈值方面匹配，但对比算子不同：对于语言模型是受试者内部错误比例差异，对于皮质是受试者间相关性差异。两种基质都恢复了一个稳健的语音偏好分离，一个深层簇和一个额顶-额下回皮质簇，均被重复验证；语义偏好方向在两种基质上均为一致的符号但非显著性趋势。因此，PRISM为转换器语言模型中的功能专业化主张提供了一个可证伪的空间分辨测试。一个确认性的ROI级干预（PRISM阶段3），允许最强因果机制主张，留待后续工作。

articles.title: Tracing Provenance and Detecting Tampering with Complementary LLM Watermarks
articles.abstract: Watermarking LLM-generated text is an important task for tracing its provenance. Existing LLM watermarks preserve provenance under editing, but this same robustness allows an adversary to alter critical content while retaining attribution, a vulnerability known as piggyback spoofing. We introduce an innovative watermark that jointly provides provenance and tamper evidence. It co-embeds a robust signal and a fragile signal into each generated token. The signals share the same mechanism but use independent keys and different seeding windows over normalized text, making one resilient to edits and the other sensitive to reader-visible changes. Multiple rounds of unbiased tournament reweighting preserve the expected generation distribution, while a periodic round-allocation pattern controls the trade-off between the two signals. At detection, their scores form a two-dimensional space supporting three decisions: Intact, Tampered, and No-Watermark. Across two large language models and two prompt datasets, our method demonstrates the highest tamper-detection rate among the evaluated methods while maintaining competitive attribution robustness and perplexity. Ablation studies show that reliable three-state detection requires a well-defined notion of intactness, co-embedding of the two signals, and complementary sensitivity to edits.
articles.titleCn: 追踪溯源与检测篡改：基于互补大型语言模型水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 为追踪其来源，给大型语言模型生成的文本打水印是一项重要任务。现有的LLM水印能在编辑过程中保留来源信息，但这种鲁棒性也允许攻击者在保留归属信息的同时篡改关键内容，这种漏洞被称为搭便车欺骗。我们引入了一种创新的水印技术，它联合提供了来源信息和篡改证据。该技术将一个鲁棒信号和一个易损信号共同嵌入到每个生成的词元中。这两个信号采用相同的嵌入机制，但使用独立的密钥，并在归一化文本上使用不同的种子窗口，使得一个信号对编辑具有抵抗力，而另一个信号对读者可见的变化敏感。多轮无偏置的锦标赛重加权保留了预期的生成分布，而周期性的轮次分配模式则控制了这两个信号之间的权衡。在检测阶段，它们的得分形成了一个二维空间，支持三种决策：完好、篡改和无水印。在两个大型语言模型和两个提示数据集上，我们的方法在评估方法中展示了最高的篡改检测率，同时保持了具有竞争力的归属鲁棒性和困惑度。消融研究表明，可靠的 трех-状态检测需要明确定义的完好性概念、两种信号的共同嵌入以及编辑的互补敏感性。

articles.title: ARC: Fair Relative Advantage Comparison in Open-Ended Real-World Interaction
articles.abstract: Open-ended real-world interaction admits multiple valid behaviors: an agent may answer directly, ask for clarification, provide progress updates, or confirm before acting. This flexibility breaks a core assumption behind group-based RL: rollouts compared within a group are no longer guaranteed to be behaviorally comparable. As a result, reward-model preferences over interaction style can distort relative advantages and steer optimization toward reward-preferred behaviors rather than context-appropriate ones. We formalize this as a \textit{reward fairness problem} and propose \textbf{ARC} (Advantage Regularization via Conditioning), a training recipe that restores fairer relative comparison through strategy-conditioned rollout grouping, together with hybrid rewards and entropy regularization. We study ARC in our proposed \inter, a novel paradigm for responsive, steerable, and execution-aware user-agent interaction that decouples user-visible communication from latent reasoning and tool use. \inter\ also provides the annotation and distillation pipeline for constructing \inter-86K, our strategy-annotated training corpus for supervised and RL training. Empirically, ARC substantially strengthens the core $τ/τ^2$ tool-use benchmarks, while \inter\ reduces time-to-first-token from 4.91s to 1.27s relative to a think-style baseline. Together, these results suggest that a central bottleneck in open-ended interactive learning is not only how agents are rewarded, but whether their behaviors are compared fairly in the first place. The ARC implementation and \inter-86K training data will be released.
articles.titleCn: 开放式现实世界交互中的公平相对优势比较：ARC
articles.abstractCn: 开放式现实交互允许多种有效行为：智能体可以直接回答、请求澄清、提供进度更新或在行动前确认。这种灵活性打破了基于群体的强化学习的一个核心假设：群体内进行比较的 rollout 不再保证行为上具有可比性。因此，对交互风格的奖励模型偏好会扭曲相对优势，并引导优化朝着奖励偏好的行为而非情境适宜的行为发展。我们将此问题形式化为一个 \textit{奖励公平问题}，并提出 \textbf{ARC} (通过条件进行优势正则化) 训练方法，该方法通过策略条件下的 rollout 分组恢复更公平的相对比较，并结合混合奖励和熵正则化。我们在我们提出的 \inter（一种响应式、可控且执行感知的用户-智能体交互新范式）中研究 ARC，该范式将用户可见的通信与潜在推理和工具使用解耦。\inter 还提供了构建 \inter-86K（我们用于监督和强化学习训练的策略标注训练语料库）的标注和蒸馏流程。实证结果表明，ARC 大幅增强了核心 $τ/τ^2$ 工具使用基准，而 \inter 相对于思考式基线将首次 token 生成时间从 4.91 秒缩短到 1.27 秒。这些结果共同表明，开放式交互学习中的一个核心瓶颈不仅在于智能体如何被奖励，更在于其行为是否从一开始就得到了公平比较。ARC 实现和 \inter-86K 训练数据将被发布。
